definition: NeuroSolutions is a neural network development environment developed by NeuroDimension.
details: It combines a modular, icon-based (component-based) network design interface with an implementation of advanced learning procedures, such as conjugate gradients, the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm, and back-propagation through time. The software is used to design, train, and deploy artificial neural network (supervised learning and unsupervised learning) models to perform a wide variety of tasks such as data mining, classification, function approximation, multivariate regression and time-series prediction.

explainer.lead: NeuroSolutions is a neural network development environment from NeuroDimension that pairs modular icon-based design with advanced learning procedures. It matters for users who want to design, train, and deploy networks without hand-coding every step.

tiers.eli5: It's a visual workbench where you snap components together like blocks to build and train a model, then put it to work.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers assemble networks from components and train them with methods such as conjugate gradients, Levenberg-Marquardt, and back-propagation through time; a pitfall is mismatching a learning procedure to the task, since time-series work calls for different methods than plain classification.
tiers.paperLevel: NeuroSolutions is a neural network development environment combining a modular, icon-based network design interface with implementations of learning procedures including conjugate gradients, the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm, and back-propagation through time, supporting supervised and unsupervised models.

explainer.example: A team builds a time-series forecasting network in the icon interface, trains it with back-propagation through time, and deploys it for prediction.
